faq.sub: What restaurateurs ask about the digital menu in IQ Rest. If your question isn't listed — message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: Do I need technical skills or CMS experience?
items.a: No special skills required. Everything in the admin panel takes a couple of taps — no coding, no working with source files. Adding a dish takes seconds: name, price, photo. A full menu setup usually fits within 30–60 minutes.

items.q: What is the IQ Rest digital menu?
items.a: It's an online version of your menu available to guests via QR code or a direct link: dish photos, prices, allergens, AI translation into 35 languages and real-time updates. The menu runs on our servers — there's no software to install or maintain, a browser is all you need.

items.q: Do guests need an app or special equipment?
items.a: A guest points their phone camera at the QR code — the menu opens in the browser, no installation. The admin panel also works in any modern browser: phone, tablet or laptop. QR codes print on a regular office printer.

items.q: Can I host the menu on my own domain?
items.a: Yes. The menu connects to your domain with an SSL certificate — guests see your restaurant's address, for example menu.yourrestaurant.com. Our support handles the domain and certificate setup; all you need to provide is a DNS record.

items.q: Can I manage multiple restaurants from one account?
items.a: Yes. Add venues to a single account: each has its own menu, design, QR codes and analytics, and switching between them takes one click. The number of venues depends on your subscription.

items.q: How hard is it to set up a menu from scratch?
items.a: Three steps: create categories, add dishes with prices and photos, print QR codes for the tables. If you have a paper menu or a PDF, upload it — AI recognizes categories, names and prices and fills in the cards automatically. A basic menu launches in 5 minutes; full setup depends on the number of items.
We reply on WhatsApp and by email during working hours. We help with initial setup, connecting your domain and menu design. Need a demo or guided onboarding — message us.
